method.alignment: Offset 0 is the scheduler step executing the injected 1024-token prefill with the full decode batch. Negative offsets precede it.
method.pairing: Same run, batch, repeat and decode request suffix; match the exact output_tokens_before ordinal per request. Average matched baseline step times over requests.
method.model_ms: schedule_return_ns to output_received_ns; host/engine wall time, not CUDA kernel time.
method.cycle_ms: Consecutive update_return_ns difference; includes model work, intervening scheduling and host/observer overhead.
method.client_ms: Mean across background requests of the singleton token-ID SSE gap for the output produced by this step. It is client arrival time, not pure GPU time.
method.aggregation: Within each trial average requests; across five repeats mean and sample SD. Steps and requests are not independent replicates.
method.windows: Fixed post-injection windows of 1, 5, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus available full-batch suffix; whole_request is original 127-gap client TPOT. No trimming of outliers.
method.recovery: First run of five consecutive post-injection steps whose absolute paired excess is <= max(1 ms, 5% baseline median, 3*1.4826*MAD). Also save 3% and 10% sensitivity. The initial window ends immediately before that run. No return => right-censored. Later threshold exceedances are retained.
method.recovery_caveat: Descriptive local-return rule, not statistical significance or causal proof of recovery. A later spike can occur. Positive and negative excesses are both included in cumulative delay.
method.coverage: Partial treatment/baseline batches are excluded and listed. Post-injection retained steps must be consecutive. Every plotted point reports its repeat count.
method.scope: Post-hoc diagnostic of existing RTX4090/Qwen measurements; not a new experiment, not a claim about the paper Figure 2 measurement window.
